completion_promises.criterion_text: Player prompt is loaded once at adapter construction via RoleConfig.load_player_prompt() (existing method)
completion_promises.evidence: LLMPlayerAdapter.__init__ (lines 51-66 of llm_player_adapter.py) calls role_config.load_player_prompt() exactly once and caches the resulting string on self._player_prompt; both respond() and revise() reference that single cached attribute rather than re-reading the prompt file per turn. The eager-load fails fast if the prompt file is missing (FileNotFoundError propagates at wiring time, not mid-turn). test_player_prompt_is_loaded_at_construction asserts adapter._player_prompt == 'PLAYER_SYSTEM_PROMPT_BODY' immediately after construction, locking the eager-load contract.

completion_promises.criterion_text: AC-LCA-04 revise(...) assembles a deterministic prompt that contains: the original learner_message, the previous previous_response, one bullet per RubricFeedback entry rendered as 'criterion_id: <id>; target_score: <score>' (no other RubricFeedback fields)
